attributes.context: The clause follows a statement that non-covered persons may operate trucks or other equipment for work not traditionally performed by covered employees, and precedes Section 34 on successors.

extraction_text: Equipment historically manned by Employees covered by this Agreement, and work historically performed by such equipment will continue to be manned and performed by Employees covered by this Agreement. Any new piece of equipment which an Employer proposes to use shall be reviewed by the Union and the Employer and an agreement reached concerning its manning, prior to its being placed in service.
